title: 菊花賞の後に・堕ちゆく

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Top Road is in the lead! Top Road is in the lead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: She did it! Top Road has done it! Top Road is our Kikuka Sho champion!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Narita Top Road is taking home the final crown of the Classic Triple Crown! Look at her smiling at the crowd as they shower her in cheers!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fans
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fans
text_block_list.text: Top Road! Congrats, Top Road!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Thank you all for your support!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe… I did it. This time I finally…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What am I doing?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's because I forgot… because I got roped into this nonsense!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I head back to my room and reflect on the day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega is clearly losing her spark.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she wants to continue dedicating her achievements to her late sister, the Arima Kinen at the end of the year could be her next goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Or maybe she'd prefer the Senior Spring Triple Crown, which I've also been prepping materials for, just in case.
choice_data_list: Or maybe… we should forget all that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To achieve her goal, I think she needs to take a bit of an extended break.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In that case, aiming for the Takarazuka Kinen next summer would be best. I begin compiling documents to present to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The night after the Kikuka Sho…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (I'm such a disgrace.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (I can do more… I have to keep pushing myself, giving everything I have…)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Until there's nothing left!)
Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: …Hi. Where are you off to? It's already past curfew.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Night training. I already put in a request.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Training, huh…

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Did you… discuss that with your trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: …You haven't, have you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe… Please don't burn yourself out.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: We just finished a race yesterday. You could at least try to rest a little more before—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What does it matter?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: This doesn't concern you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: It does too! What are you even saying?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: We've race each other in the Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, the Kikuka Sho, and even long before that!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: After all that running, all those races… do you really think I don't care about you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Stop.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: You're going to get yourself hurt! Please, you need to take care of yourself!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Stop it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Please, just go back to your dorm and get some rest!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: You can gather your strength, then you can get back to training…

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: That way, when we compete again—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Stop it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her sharp rejection echoes through the still air of the night.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Just stop. You've said enough.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Just stay away from me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …You shine too bright.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: So don't come any closer. Don't shine your light on me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Or else I won't be able to see her. I won't be able to talk to her anymore.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: The starlight can't reach me unless I'm in the dark. I have to stay in the darkness…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: So, please… please.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Don't shine your light on me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The night is painted in a deep and gloomy darkness…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While the faint starlight glows over my documents for the Takarazuka Kinen.
